flags: All three NCDOT guidebook cache files contain the same truncated opening material and stop during Historic Flat Rock; the Upper Yadkin section is absent despite URL fragments. No route-specific DOT evaluation, length, drive time or designation date can be recovered. Overview is shorter and uses the highway article’s state-byway identification.
Dropped current 26.3 miles, about 35 minutes, Yadkin origin near Blowing Rock and later Pee Dee name: no supporting passage in cache. Dropped farms/pastures around Ferguson for the same reason.
The highway article places the scenic corridor between US 321 and the reservoir, not explicitly all the way to Wilkesboro. Story treats Wilkesboro as the highway’s onward direction.
Ferguson remains a short moment because cache gives only a brief museum and graves description. No claim of guilt, burial access, current events schedule or museum opening is made.

Fort Defiance history rests on a short secondary account. Cache identifies a plantation but provides no account of enslaved people or labor; this is a material gap for fuller interpretation. No current museum access asserted.
Short overview and Ferguson moment are intentional evidence limits; no guidebook-only claims have been restored to meet a word target.
